question.text: Units of which type of Category III AIF scheme are eligible for listing on a recognised stock exchange?

answer.text: Only close-ended schemes, voluntary listing with minimum tradable lot of Rs. 1 crore
Both open and close-ended, with no lot size
No Cat III AIF units are eligible for listing

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 117 of the workbook, units of close-ended Category III AIF schemes are eligible for voluntary listing on a recognised stock exchange after final close, with a minimum tradable lot of Rs. 1 crore. The Trap: Open-ended schemes already permit periodic redemption and are not eligible for listing; listing is also not unconditional or lot-size-free. Note: Listing is voluntary and is permitted only after the scheme's final close.
